idea-plugin.name: Easy Extension
idea-plugin.description:
IntelliJ IDEA support for the Easy-Extension extension point framework.

  • Gutter icons on @ExtensionPoint interfaces to navigate to all implementations (Ability / Business / Default); requires Easy-Extension 4.x
  • Gutter icons on @Ability / @Business classes to navigate to corresponding extension point interfaces (and, for a business, to the abilities in its abilities list)
  • Resolution chains follow the order of @Business(abilities = {...}), with Self.class marking the business itself
  • Gutter icons on @ExtensionInject fields to navigate to extension point definitions
  • Tool Window panel showing the topology of all extension points in the project
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.1.1

  • No longer uses the read-action API deprecated in IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1

2.1.0

  • Supports IntelliJ IDEA 2025.1 and later (2025.1 - 2026.2); 2024.x is no longer supported

2.0.0

  • Supports Easy-Extension 4.x: @Business(abilities = {...}) as an ordered list of ability classes, with Self.class marking the business itself
  • Navigation for @DefaultImplementation (one default implementation per extension point)
  • Requires Easy-Extension 4.x; 3.x annotations ("code::n" strings, @ExtensionPointDefaultImplementation) are not recognized
